paras.text: How to change the simple future tense into the future continuous tense:
paras.urdu: سادہ مستقبل کو مستقبل جاری میں کیسے بدلیں:
paras.pashto: ساده راتلونکی زمان څنګه په راتلونکي روان زمان بدل کړو:

paras.text: To express an action that is expected to take place in future and be completed , we use the simple future tense. For example when you have to attend a meeting in the committee room at 11 o'clock tomorrow , you say: I will arrive the committee room at 11 o'clock and will be meeting with the delegates.
paras.urdu: کسی ایسے کام کو ظاہر کرنے کے لیے جس کا مستقبل میں ہونا اور مکمل ہونا متوقع ہو، ہم سادہ مستقبل استعمال کرتے ہیں۔ مثلاً جب آپ کو کل 11 بجے کمیٹی روم میں اجلاس میں شرکت کرنی ہو تو آپ کہتے ہیں: I will arrive the committee room at 11 o'clock and will be meeting with the delegates.
paras.pashto: د داسې کار د څرګندولو لپاره چې تمه کېږي په راتلونکي کې ترسره او بشپړ شي، ساده راتلونکی زمان کاروو. د بېلګې په توګه کله چې باید سبا په 11 بجو د کمېټې په کوټه کې په غونډه کې ګډون وکړئ، وایئ: I will arrive the committee room at 11 o'clock and will be meeting with the delegates.

paras.text: I will arrive the simple future tense of the verb ' to arrive'. It shows that you arrive once; after that you cannot keep on arriving . However, once the action of arriving at the committee room is completed, you may be doing something that goes on continuously, at least for a certain period of time. For that, you will say, 'I will be meeting with the delegates.'
paras.urdu: I will arrive فعل ’to arrive‘ کا سادہ مستقبل ہے۔ یہ ظاہر کرتا ہے کہ آپ ایک بار پہنچتے ہیں؛ اس کے بعد آپ مسلسل پہنچتے نہیں رہ سکتے۔ تاہم کمیٹی روم پہنچنے کا عمل مکمل ہونے کے بعد آپ کوئی ایسا کام کر رہے ہو سکتے ہیں جو کم از کم کچھ وقت تک مسلسل جاری رہے۔ اس کے لیے آپ کہیں گے: 'I will be meeting with the delegates.'
paras.pashto: I will arrive د 'to arrive' فعل ساده راتلونکی زمان دی. ښيي چې یو ځل رسېږئ؛ وروسته نه شئ کولی چې رسېدو ته دوام ورکړئ. خو کله چې د کمېټې کوټې ته د رسېدو کار بشپړ شي، کېدای شي داسې کار وکړئ چې لږ تر لږه د یوې ټاکلې مودې لپاره دوام ولري. د دې لپاره به وایئ: 'I will be meeting with the delegates.'

paras.text: Will be meeting he future continuous tense of the verb 'to meet'. The construction will+be+present participle (meeting) indicates that the action of meeting will last for a certain duration.
paras.urdu: Will be meeting فعل ’to meet‘ کا مستقبل جاری ہے۔ will+be+حال کا اسمِ فاعل (meeting) کی ساخت ظاہر کرتی ہے کہ ملاقات کا عمل کچھ مدت تک جاری رہے گا۔
paras.pashto: Will be meeting د 'to meet' فعل راتلونکی روان زمان دی. د will+be+اوسني صفت فاعلي (meeting) جوړښت ښيي چې د لیدنې کار به د یوې ټاکلې مودې لپاره دوام ولري.

paras.text: So, you see that the form of a simple future tense is changed to the form of the future continuous tense by putting be + ing form of the verb after shall/will.
paras.urdu: تو آپ دیکھتے ہیں کہ shall/will کے بعد be + فعل کی ing شکل لگا کر سادہ مستقبل کی شکل مستقبل جاری کی شکل میں بدل جاتی ہے۔
paras.pashto: نو وینئ چې د shall/will وروسته د be + د فعل ing بڼې په ایښودو د ساده راتلونکي زمان بڼه په راتلونکي روان زمان بدلېږي.

paras.text: C. Future Perfect Tense
paras.urdu: C. مستقبل مکمل
paras.pashto: C. راتلونکی بشپړ زمان

paras.text: Defnition: Future perfect tense is used to express an action that is is assumed to be completed later than now ( the time while talking ) and before some other action or a specified point of time in future. When we use this tense, we are projecting ourselves forward into the future and looking back at an action that will be completed sometime later than now.
paras.urdu: تعریف: مستقبل مکمل کسی ایسے کام کو ظاہر کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جس کے بارے میں فرض کیا جائے کہ وہ اب (بات کرنے کے وقت) کے بعد اور مستقبل میں کسی دوسرے کام یا مقررہ وقت سے پہلے مکمل ہو جائے گا۔ اس زمانے کو استعمال کرتے وقت ہم خود کو مستقبل میں آگے لے جاتے ہیں اور ایک ایسے کام کو پیچھے مڑ کر دیکھتے ہیں جو اب کے بعد کسی وقت مکمل ہو گا۔
paras.pashto: تعریف: راتلونکی بشپړ زمان د داسې کار د څرګندولو لپاره کارول کېږي چې ګڼل کېږي له اوس (د خبرو له وخت) وروسته او په راتلونکي کې له بل کار یا ټاکلي وخت مخکې بشپړ شي. کله چې دا زمان کاروو، ځانونه راتلونکي ته وړاندې وړو او هغه کار ته شاته ګورو چې له اوس وروسته به یو وخت بشپړ شي.

paras.text: Explanation:
paras.urdu: وضاحت:
paras.pashto: تشریح:

paras.text: Consider the example,
paras.urdu: اس مثال پر غور کریں،
paras.pashto: دا بېلګه په پام کې ونیسئ،

paras.text: " Suppose It is 8 a.m by your watch now.The train will leave the station at 9 a.m while, Haris will arrive at the station at 9.15 a.m.
paras.urdu: ’’فرض کریں اب آپ کی گھڑی میں صبح کے 8 بجے ہیں۔ ٹرین صبح 9 بجے اسٹیشن سے روانہ ہو گی جبکہ حارث 9:15 بجے اسٹیشن پہنچے گا۔
paras.pashto: "فرض کړئ اوس ستاسو په ساعت سهار 8 بجې دي. اورګاډی به سهار 9 بجې له سټېشن روان شي، په داسې حال کې چې حارث به 9:15 بجې سټېشن ته ورسېږي.

paras.text: So, when Haris arrives at the station, the train will have left."
paras.urdu: چنانچہ جب حارث اسٹیشن پہنچے گا تو ٹرین جا چکی ہو گی (the train will have left)۔‘‘
paras.pashto: نو کله چې حارث سټېشن ته ورسېږي، اورګاډی به تللی وي (the train will have left)."

paras.text: 'Will have left' indicates that the action of leaving by the train will be complete before the action of arriving of Haris; and both the actions will take place in the future.
paras.urdu: ’Will have left‘ ظاہر کرتا ہے کہ ٹرین کے روانہ ہونے کا عمل حارث کے پہنچنے کے عمل سے پہلے مکمل ہو گا؛ اور دونوں عمل مستقبل میں ہوں گے۔
paras.pashto: 'Will have left' ښيي چې د اورګاډي د تګ کار به د حارث د رسېدو له کار مخکې بشپړ شي؛ او دواړه کارونه به په راتلونکي کې ترسره شي.

paras.text: Note that if two actions take place in the future, the first one is future perfect tense and Second one is simple present tense. Such as 'The teacher will have started the lesson before you reach.'
paras.urdu: نوٹ کریں کہ اگر دو کام مستقبل میں ہوں تو پہلا مستقبل مکمل اور دوسرا سادہ حال میں ہوتا ہے۔ جیسے 'The teacher will have started the lesson before you reach.'
paras.pashto: پام وکړئ چې که دوه کارونه په راتلونکي کې وي، لومړی راتلونکی بشپړ او دویم ساده حال زمان وي. لکه 'The teacher will have started the lesson before you reach.'

paras.text: Form of the future perfect tense
paras.urdu: مستقبل مکمل کی ساخت
paras.pashto: د راتلونکي بشپړ زمان جوړښت

paras.text: The form of the future perfect tense is pretty simple. Its structure is subject + auxiliary verb(will)+auxiliary verb (have)+ past participle of the main verb.
paras.urdu: مستقبل مکمل کی ساخت کافی سادہ ہے۔ اس کی ساخت یہ ہے: فاعل + امدادی فعل (will) + امدادی فعل (have) + اصل فعل کا ماضی کا اسمِ مفعول۔
paras.pashto: د راتلونکي بشپړ زمان بڼه ډېره ساده ده. جوړښت یې دا دی: فاعل + مرستندوی فعل (will) + مرستندوی فعل (have) + د اصلي فعل تېر صفت مفعولي.

paras.text: Look at these examples:

sections.theory:
How to change the simple future tense into the future continuous tense:

To express an action that is expected to take place in future and be completed , we use the simple future tense. For example when you have to attend a meeting in the committee room at 11 o'clock tomorrow , you say: I will arrive the committee room at 11 o'clock and will be meeting with the delegates.

I will arrive the simple future tense of the verb ' to arrive'. It shows that you arrive once; after that you cannot keep on arriving . However, once the action of arriving at the committee room is completed, you may be doing something that goes on continuously, at least for a certain period of time. For that, you will say, 'I will be meeting with the delegates.'

Will be meeting he future continuous tense of the verb 'to meet'. The construction will+be+present participle (meeting) indicates that the action of meeting will last for a certain duration.

So, you see that the form of a simple future tense is changed to the form of the future continuous tense by putting be + ing form of the verb after shall/will.

Some other examples of the future continuous tense are:

Haris will be doing jogging in the evening.

Hammad will be watching TV at night.

I shall be helping you.

She will be washing clothes on Sunday.

Afaq will be earning a lot right after completing his education.

Activity

Put the verbs given in the brackets into the correct form of the future continuous tense:

1. At this time tomorrow, I ____ (leave).

2. We ____ (have) a party on the last Saturday of the month.

3. I ____ (drive) during rain.

4. He ____ (not take) the bus today.

5. Where ____ (sleep) tonight?

6. Don't forget your warm clothes. It ____ (snow) by the time you get to Murree.

7. Sorry, I can't join you. I ____ (take) my daughter to school at that time.

8. You ____ (feel) thirsty while working in the sun.

9. You ____ (miss) the sunshine in England.

10. My son ____ (stay) in Saudi Arabia with his uncle .

11. Inanhour,I ____ (sit) in my staff room .

12. Tomorrow at noon, he ____ (work) in his fields.

13. We ____ (have) a dinnertogether.

14. Nextyear, She ____ (appear) in her final exams.

15. This moment, children ____ (play) in the ground.

C. Future Perfect Tense

Defnition: Future perfect tense is used to express an action that is is assumed to be completed later than now ( the time while talking ) and before some other action or a specified point of time in future. When we use this tense, we are projecting ourselves forward into the future and looking back at an action that will be completed sometime later than now.

Explanation:

Consider the example,

" Suppose It is 8 a.m by your watch now.The train will leave the station at 9 a.m while, Haris will arrive at the station at 9.15 a.m.

So, when Haris arrives at the station, the train will have left."

'Will have left' indicates that the action of leaving by the train will be complete before the action of arriving of Haris; and both the actions will take place in the future.

Note that if two actions take place in the future, the first one is future perfect tense and Second one is simple present tense. Such as 'The teacher will have started the lesson before you reach.'

Form of the future perfect tense

The form of the future perfect tense is pretty simple. Its structure is subject + auxiliary verb(will)+auxiliary verb (have)+ past participle of the main verb.

Look at these examples:

He (subject)+will (auxiliary verb)+have(auxiliary verb) +achieved (past participle) his target by the next month.

He will have taken admission in the college in 2021 .

The match will have ended by the time Salim gets out of bed.

I will have left early in the morning before my son gets up.

sections.content:
How to change the simple future tense into the future continuous tense:

To express an action that is expected to take place in future and be completed , we use the simple future tense. For example when you have to attend a meeting in the committee room at 11 o'clock tomorrow , you say: I will arrive the committee room at 11 o'clock and will be meeting with the delegates.

I will arrive the simple future tense of the verb ' to arrive'. It shows that you arrive once; after that you cannot keep on arriving . However, once the action of arriving at the committee room is completed, you may be doing something that goes on continuously, at least for a certain period of time. For that, you will say, 'I will be meeting with the delegates.'

Will be meeting he future continuous tense of the verb 'to meet'. The construction will+be+present participle (meeting) indicates that the action of meeting will last for a certain duration.

So, you see that the form of a simple future tense is changed to the form of the future continuous tense by putting be + ing form of the verb after shall/will.

Some other examples of the future continuous tense are:

Haris will be doing jogging in the evening.

Hammad will be watching TV at night.

I shall be helping you.

She will be washing clothes on Sunday.

Afaq will be earning a lot right after completing his education.

Activity

1. At this time tomorrow, I ____ (leave).

2. We ____ (have) a party on the last Saturday of the month.

3. I ____ (drive) during rain.

4. He ____ (not take) the bus today.

5. Where ____ (sleep) tonight?

6. Don't forget your warm clothes. It ____ (snow) by the time you get to Murree.

7. Sorry, I can't join you. I ____ (take) my daughter to school at that time.

8. You ____ (feel) thirsty while working in the sun.

9. You ____ (miss) the sunshine in England.

10. My son ____ (stay) in Saudi Arabia with his uncle .

11. Inanhour,I ____ (sit) in my staff room .

12. Tomorrow at noon, he ____ (work) in his fields.

13. We ____ (have) a dinnertogether.

14. Nextyear, She ____ (appear) in her final exams.

15. This moment, children ____ (play) in the ground.

C. Future Perfect Tense

Defnition: Future perfect tense is used to express an action that is is assumed to be completed later than now ( the time while talking ) and before some other action or a specified point of time in future. When we use this tense, we are projecting ourselves forward into the future and looking back at an action that will be completed sometime later than now.

Explanation:

Consider the example,

" Suppose It is 8 a.m by your watch now.The train will leave the station at 9 a.m while, Haris will arrive at the station at 9.15 a.m.

So, when Haris arrives at the station, the train will have left."

'Will have left' indicates that the action of leaving by the train will be complete before the action of arriving of Haris; and both the actions will take place in the future.

Note that if two actions take place in the future, the first one is future perfect tense and Second one is simple present tense. Such as 'The teacher will have started the lesson before you reach.'

Form of the future perfect tense

The form of the future perfect tense is pretty simple. Its structure is subject + auxiliary verb(will)+auxiliary verb (have)+ past participle of the main verb.

Look at these examples:

He (subject)+will (auxiliary verb)+have(auxiliary verb) +achieved (past participle) his target by the next month.

He will have taken admission in the college in 2021 .

The match will have ended by the time Salim gets out of bed.

I will have left early in the morning before my son gets up.
